event_and_rows.gas_utilization: event block gasUsed/gasLimit; neutral 0.5 only after a disclosed transport failure

funding.cashflow: long pays positive funding and receives negative funding; short opposite
funding.fallback: adverse unsigned 2 bp per crossed UTC 00/08/16 boundary, never a credit
funding.primary: Bybit V5 public funding history at fundingRateTimestamp

labels_and_execution.label: upper versus lower frozen pool touched first
labels_and_execution.source_boundary: full structural stop plus all cost
labels_and_execution.stop_fill: worse of stop and adverse minute open
labels_and_execution.target_fill: frozen target with no favorable gap improvement

market_data.availability: one-minute bar usable only after close; entry is next exact contiguous minute open strictly after event availability
market_data.gaps: never imputed; reset structural and rolling state and invalidate crossed labels
market_data.provider: Bybit official public MetaTrader4 one-minute kline archive

model.calibration: one IsotonicRegression out_of_bounds=clip when frozen calibration has >=50 resolved rows and both classes; otherwise raw probability
model.imputation: training-partition numeric median with empty-feature preservation

official_2024H1.decision: report complete path; negative or concentration-fragile result retires immediately; a robust positive result informs a 2024H2 version frozen only with information through 2024-06-30
official_2024H1.evaluation: same features/model/action/execution and frozen risk/cap; no 2024H1 input selects its own version

parallel_transport.reason: independent runner capacity; identical Blockscout source gate and frozen economic code

purpose: Make a source pass immediately executable through the frozen pre-2024 ML screen, broad risk search and official 2024H1 sequential research interval without adding another purity gate.

risk_search.selection: highest 24-bp geometric daily growth on untouched 2023H2 among no-liquidation, positive winner-removed paths; no 1% cap

structural_liquidity.active_pool: confirmed pivot remains active until a completed one-minute bar consumes it
structural_liquidity.bar: exact contiguous completed UTC 60-minute OHLC from Bybit one-minute bars
structural_liquidity.confirmation: two complete hourly bars on the right
structural_liquidity.entry_requires: nearest active upper and lower pools each at least 12 bp from entry
